info.name: Patient Management API
info.description:
A production-grade Serverless Patient Management API built with Node.js 20+ & TypeScript (strict mode), Express.js on AWS Lambda via API Gateway, DynamoDB (single-table design with GSI), OpenSearch for full-text condition search, and Cognito JWT authentication.

## Authentication
Protected endpoints require a valid Cognito access token:
```
Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}
```

## Standard Response Format
```json
{
  "success": true | false,
  "data": {},
  "message": "string",
  "errors": [],
  "meta": {}
}
```

## Environment Variables
Set the following collection variables before using:
- `base_url` — Local: `http://localhost:3000`, AWS: `https://{apiId}.execute-api.{region}.amazonaws.com/{stage}`
- `access_token` — Cognito JWT access token (required for protected endpoints)
- `patient_id` — UUID of a patient (auto-set by Create Patient test script)

item.name: 👤 Patients
item.description: Full CRUD operations for patient records. Protected endpoints (Create, Update, Delete) require a valid Cognito Bearer token. Read operations (List, Get by ID, Search) are publicly accessible.

request.description:
Creates a new patient record in DynamoDB and indexes it in OpenSearch for full-text search capabilities.

**Requires authentication** — include a valid Cognito Bearer token.

**Required fields:**
- `name` (string, 2–100 chars)
- `address` (string, 5–255 chars)

**Optional fields:**
- `conditions` (array of strings) — list of medical conditions
- `allergies` (array of strings) — list of known allergies

The API auto-generates a UUID `patientId` and sets `createdAt` / `updatedAt` timestamps.

response.name: 201 Created — Complete Patient
201 Created — Minimal Fields
400 Bad Request — Validation Error
401 Unauthorized — Missing/Invalid Token

query.description: Filter patients by exact address (uses AddressIndex DynamoDB GSI). Leave empty to list all patients.
Maximum number of patients to return (1–100, default 20).
Base64-encoded pagination cursor from the previous response's meta.lastEvaluatedKey. Leave empty for the first page.

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of all patient records from DynamoDB.

**No authentication required.**

**Query Parameters:**
- `address` *(optional)* — Filter patients by exact address using the `AddressIndex` GSI
- `limit` *(optional)* — Number of records per page (1–100, default: 20)
- `lastEvaluatedKey` *(optional)* — Base64-encoded cursor for pagination (from previous response)

**Pagination:** When the response includes `meta.lastEvaluatedKey`, pass it as the `lastEvaluatedKey` query param to retrieve the next page.

query.description: Medical condition to search for. Supports fuzzy matching via OpenSearch. REQUIRED.
Maximum number of results to return (1–100, default 20).

request.description:
Searches patient records using OpenSearch full-text search on the `conditions` field. Supports **fuzzy matching**, meaning slight misspellings (e.g. `diabets`) will still return relevant results.

**No authentication required.**

**Query Parameters:**
- `condition` *(required)* — The medical condition to search for
- `limit` *(optional)* — Number of results per page (1–100, default: 20)
- `from` *(optional)* — Pagination offset (default: 0)

**Note:** The `/search` route is declared before `/:id` in the router to prevent route conflicts.

response.name: 200 OK — Matching Patients Found
200 OK — No Patients Found
200 OK — Paginated Search (Second Page)
400 Bad Request — Missing condition Parameter

request.description:
Retrieves a single patient record by their UUID from DynamoDB.

**No authentication required.**

**Path Parameters:**
- `id` *(required)* — UUID v4 of the patient (e.g. `123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000`)

Returns `404` if the patient does not exist, or `400` if the provided ID is not a valid UUID format.

response.name: 200 OK — Patient Found
400 Bad Request — Invalid UUID Format
404 Not Found — Patient Does Not Exist

request.description:
Updates one or more fields of an existing patient record in DynamoDB and re-indexes the updated record in OpenSearch.

**Requires authentication** — include a valid Cognito Bearer token.

**Path Parameters:**
- `id` *(required)* — UUID v4 of the patient to update

**Request Body** (all fields optional, but at least one must be provided):
- `name` (string, 2–100 chars)
- `address` (string, 5–255 chars)
- `conditions` (array of strings)
- `allergies` (array of strings)

The `updatedAt` timestamp is automatically updated. The `patientId`, `createdAt` fields cannot be modified.

response.name: 200 OK — Patient Updated
200 OK — Address Updated Only
400 Bad Request — Validation Error
401 Unauthorized
404 Not Found — Patient Does Not Exist

request.description:
Permanently deletes a patient record from both DynamoDB and OpenSearch index. This action is **irreversible**.

**Requires authentication** — include a valid Cognito Bearer token.

**Path Parameters:**
- `id` *(required)* — UUID v4 of the patient to delete

Returns `204 No Content` on success (no response body). Returns `404` if the patient does not exist.

response.name: 401 Unauthorized
404 Not Found — Patient Does Not Exist
